lines.en: label chikaspringnightgen:
scene chikaspringnightgen
I make my way over to Chika’s apartment to spend the night with her while Yumi and Chinami sit in the living room reading manga together.
lines.zh: 我前往 Chika 的公寓陪她过夜，Yumi 和 Chinami 坐在客厅里一起看漫画。

lines.en: Neither of them pay any attention to me, so I’m free to spend the night out on the balcony with one of my several girlfriends as tonight's selection locks her eyes on mine.
lines.zh: 她们俩都没注意我，于是我可以自由地跟我的几个女朋友之一在阳台上度过这一夜——今晚的这一位正盯着我的眼睛。

lines.en: I can't help but wonder what she's thinking, but I neglect to ask because I don't want her answer to penetrate me the same way I do her on a routine basis.
lines.zh: 我忍不住想知道她在想什么，但我没问，因为我不想让她的回答像我平常刺穿她那样刺穿我。

lines.en: It's both interesting and unfortunate how easily I crack now. But I guess it's easier for hairline fractures to form once the first one has already begun to spread.
lines.zh: 我现在这么容易崩裂，既有趣又悲哀。不过我想，一旦第一道裂缝开始蔓延，之后再形成发丝般的细裂就容易多了。

lines.en: I crumble and ask her anyway. I ask her why she stares at me the way she does. And what she tells me is this-
lines.zh: 我还是崩不住问了。我问她为什么那样盯着我看。而她告诉我是这样的——

lines.en: I just want to.
She just wants to.
What a terrible waste of time.
scene black
One more crack forms and I remind myself of thoughts I've had on other balconies.
lines.zh: 又一道裂缝形成，我想起自己在别的阳台上曾有过的念头。

lines.en: Thoughts of when we wanted one another, and when we could do that without really caring about how or why.
lines.zh: 那些关于我们曾经渴望彼此的念头，那时我们可以不管方式、不问缘由地去做。

lines.en: But now, I think too much.
And all those thoughts revolve around self-destructing and what it would do to this makeshift family of ours.
lines.zh: 而所有这些念头都绕着自我毁灭，以及那会给我们这个凑合起来的家带来什么。

lines.en: Regretfully, I don't think I'd be able to crawl away anymore.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，我想我已经爬不走了。
